summary: Rwanda's Directorate General of Immigration and Emigration says citizens of all countries can get a visa on arrival without prior application. Citizens of African Union, Commonwealth and Francophonie member states get it with the fee waived for a visit of 30 days; nationals of the countries on a separate list — among them Ghana, Senegal, Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines and Qatar — get a 90-day visa free of charge; East African Community citizens get a free pass for six months. The directorate says visa fees must not exceed USD 50 for a single entry, and that visitors can also apply online or at a Rwandan mission before departure.

notes: Canada's travel advice says non-biodegradable bags are prohibited in Rwanda and will be confiscated if you arrive with them at the airport in Kigali, and that importing or using electronic cigarettes or vaporizers is illegal. The UK Foreign Office says you must declare drones when you arrive.

payments.text: Canada's travel advice says Rwanda is a cash-based economy in which electronic payments and online banking are becoming more available: credit cards are usually accepted at most hotels and lodges and at most businesses, restaurants and shops in Kigali, but expect to handle other expenses in cash. It says some ATMs may not accept foreign bank cards, and that most shops will not accept or exchange US dollars printed before 2006.

safety.text: The UK Foreign Office advises against all but essential travel to the parts of Rusizi District within 10km of the border with the Democratic Republic of Congo, including the Rwandan islands in Lake Kivu and Kamembe Airport. It says crime levels are relatively low in Rwanda, but there are cases of burglary, theft, bag-snatching and mugging in Kigali, and that opening hours at the Gisenyi-Goma and Cyangugu-Bukavu land border crossings vary.

idp.text: Rwanda is a party to the 1949 Geneva Convention on Road Traffic (UN Treaty Collection). The UK government tells British drivers they need both the 1949 international driving permit (IDP) and their UK driving licence in the car, and that after one year of driving they must have a Rwandan licence. Canada's travel advice tells Canadians they must carry an International Driving Permit. No Rwandan official source we could read states Rwanda's own rule on whether a permit is required in addition to a national licence.

tips.text: The UK Foreign Office says there is a ban on plastic bags in Rwanda and that plastic bags you have when you arrive will be confiscated.
The UK Foreign Office says the last Saturday of each month is Umuganda, a national day of community service, when most normal services close from 7am to 11am.

Canada advises a high degree of caution in parts of Rubavu and Rusizi districts due to the proximity of rebel groups in the DRC along the border, and says crossing at the Gisenyi-Goma and Cyangugu-Bukavu land border crossings is prohibited for most travellers.

Rwanda's immigration directorate says the East Africa Tourist Visa costs US$100, is valid for 90 days and is multiple entry if staying within Rwanda, Kenya and Uganda. If you get it before travel, your first entry point must be the country through which you applied.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Rwanda?
faq.answer: Rwanda's immigration directorate says citizens of all countries can get a visa on arrival without prior application. Citizens of African Union, Commonwealth and Francophonie member states get it with the fee waived for a visit of 30 days, nationals of the countries on its 90-day list (among them Ghana, Senegal, Singapore, Indonesia, the Philippines and Qatar) get a 90-day visa free of charge, East African Community citizens get a free pass for six months, and the fees must not exceed USD 50 for a single-entry visa.

faq.question: How does Rwanda's visa on arrival work?
faq.answer: Rwanda's immigration directorate says nationals of all countries receive a visa on arrival at Kigali International Airport and all land borders, and that the fees must not exceed USD 50 for a single-entry visa or USD 70 for multiple entry. You can also apply online or at a Rwandan mission before departure; those applying online can pay online or on arrival.

faq.question: What is the East Africa Tourist Visa?
faq.answer: Rwanda's immigration directorate says the East Africa Tourist Visa, for visiting Rwanda, Kenya and Uganda for tourism, costs US$100, is valid for 90 days and is multiple entry if staying within the three countries. You can apply online through Irembo, on arrival or at a Rwandan mission abroad; if you get it before travel, your first entry point must be the country through which you applied.

faq.question: Is Rwanda safe to visit?
faq.answer: The UK Foreign Office says crime levels are relatively low in Rwanda, but there are cases of burglary, theft, bag-snatching and mugging in Kigali. It advises against all but essential travel to the parts of Rusizi District within 10km of the border with the Democratic Republic of Congo, including the Rwandan islands in Lake Kivu and Kamembe Airport.

faq.question: Do I need a yellow fever vaccination for Rwanda?
faq.answer: The UK Foreign Office says that if you're coming from a country listed as a transmission risk, you must have a certificate to prove you've had a yellow fever vaccination. Rwanda's immigration directorate says a vaccination certificate may be required at the border post.

faq.question: Can I extend my stay in Rwanda?
faq.answer: Rwanda's immigration directorate says some visa classes may be extended, with details set out in the information for applicants for each class; an extension application is submitted at the directorate's offices while the initial visa remains valid. It allows a grace period of 5 days after a visa expires to depart or renew it without a penalty.

summary.text: From 1 Jan 2018, Citizens of all countries are allowed to get visa upon arrival without prior application.
Citizens of countries members to the following international organizations; African Union, Commonwealth and La Francophonie get visa upon arrival and are waived visa fees for a visit of 30 days.

The following countries to be granted 90 days valid visa free of charge upon arrival: Angola, Benin, Central African Republic, Chad, Cote d’Ivoire, Democratic Republic of Congo, The Federation of Saint Christopher and Nevis, Ghana, Guinea, Indonesia, Haiti, Mauritius, Philippines, Senegal, Seychelles, Sierra Leone, Sao Tome and Principe, Singapore and the state Qatar.
A citizen of East African Community Member States shall be issued a pass/entry visa free of charge upon arrival to stay for the period of six months.
The visa fees must not exceed 50 USD for single entry visa or 70 USD for multiple entry.

Citizens of all countries that all not visa exempt have also option to submit application online or at the Rwanda Diplomatic Missions of the country of residence before departure. Those applying online have the option to pay online or upon arrival.
